thread:
maria: Quick ping  I'm opening a small PR to add a 'capacity allocator' example in the Dedicated runbook. Goal: show how label-based routing + allocator hints interact with autoscale. Need short engineering + UX review.

ethan: Nice. Can you keep the example tiny? People copy/paste into infra templates.

maria: Yep. Draft YAML I'm adding:
```yaml
tenantId: "team-omega"
labels:
  - mission:payments
  - priority:high
allocatorHints:
  preferReservedPool: true
  maxBurstInstances: 4
scalePolicy:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 24
  cooldown: 120
```

vikram: Small API nit: our SDK uses `allocator` not `allocatorHints` in examples. Add a one-line SDK mapping to avoid confusion.

maria: Good call, adding a mapping table and a JS snippet: 
```js
// SDK example
await client.dedicated.create({
  tenantId: 'team-omega',
  labels: ['mission:payments','priority:high'],
  allocator: { preferReservedPool: true, maxBurstInstances: 4 },
  scalePolicy: { minReplicas: 2, maxReplicas: 24, cooldown: 120 }
});
```

orson: Also note in text: `preferReservedPool: true` is a hint, not a guarantee. If capacity constrained, the allocator may place workload on transient nodes. Add a callout.

maria: Added a caution note and reworded the SLA examples to be illustrative. Wording: "Illustrative p95 target (non-contractual): Committed ~200ms under provisioned load."

ethan: Link nit: the runbook referenced infra module `infra/dedicated` but infra team renamed it to `infra/dedicated-allocator`. Update the Terraform example.

maria: Updated the TF source in the example and pushed. Also added a tiny terraform snippet for allocator flags.

vikram: One more: please add a short troubleshooting bullet: "Allocator ignored reserved hint" -> check tenant labels, reserved pool quotas, and infra capacity in target region.

maria: Done. Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1207  title: "Dedicated: capacity allocator example + SDK mapping". Requested reviewers: ethan, vikram.

docs-bot: PR opened by maria: PR #1207  Requested reviewers: ethan, vikram. Preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1207

ethan: Quick approve from me after CI. One last nit: prefer customer-facing copy to say "workspace" while keeping API examples with "tenant".

maria: Switched headings to "workspace" for the user guide. Kept API snippets as-is. Pushed.

vikram: LGTM pending docs CI. Thanks, short and useful.

maria: Thanks all  will merge when CI + approvals are green.
